activities.activity_description: Review the current proprietary Cloud Foundry client implementation in the CC SPI deployer to map all required functionality that must be preserved during the refactor.

activities.activity_name: Refactor CC SPI deployer to use CF Java Client
activities.activity_description: Replace the proprietary Cloud Foundry client with the official Cloud Foundry Java Client, updating internal deployer logic to use the new client's APIs while maintaining the existing CC SPI public interface.

activities.activity_name: Validate refactored CC SPI deployer functionality
activities.activity_description: Run existing unit tests for the CC SPI deployer, perform manual testing of core Cloud Foundry deployment workflows to confirm no regressions in functionality.

activities.activity_name: Design Hadoop distribution abstraction layer
activities.activity_description: Define the interface for runtime Hadoop library loading, the configuration property for specifying the target distribution, and the list of default supported distributions.

activities.activity_name: Implement Hadoop distribution abstraction layer
activities.activity_description: Code the runtime library loading logic for each supported Hadoop distribution, add configuration handling to select the appropriate distribution at application startup.

activities.activity_name: Validate Hadoop distribution selection functionality
activities.activity_description: Test that the correct Hadoop client libraries are loaded for each supported distribution, verify that the default distribution is used when no explicit selection is provided.

activities.activity_name: Analyze existing header-enricher module structure
activities.activity_description: Review the header-enricher module code, dependencies, and build configuration in the modules repo to identify integration requirements with the XD core codebase.

activities.activity_name: Integrate header-enricher into XD core codebase
activities.activity_description: Move the header-enricher source code into the XD repository, update its dependencies to match XD's current dependency versions, and adjust build configuration as needed.

activities.activity_name: Validate integrated header-enricher functionality
activities.activity_description: Run existing tests for the header-enricher in the XD core context, fix any test failures caused by dependency or configuration changes during integration.

activities.activity_name: Analyze dependency upgrade impact
activities.activity_description: Review all modules affected by the dependency upgrade to Spring Integration 4.2, Spring Framework 4.2.1, and Spring AMQP 1.5, identify deprecated APIs and breaking changes that require code updates.

activities.activity_name: Perform coordinated dependency upgrade across all modules
activities.activity_description: Update Maven pom.xml files for all affected modules to use the target dependency versions, modify code to replace deprecated API usage and maintain existing functionality.

activities.activity_name: Validate post-upgrade functionality
activities.activity_description: Run full unit and integration test suites for all modules to identify and fix any regressions caused by the dependency upgrade.
